title: Clash Realms
body:
CLASH REALMS
DISCORD | WIKI

Clash Realms is a powerful plugin to add robust and engaging
 guilds to your Minecraft server, f
ostering community and competition with
 a seamless guild system.

Guild Roles & Permissions
Leader: Full control (invite, kick, promote, demote, disband, transfer leadership).
Officer: Can invite, kick regular members, and promote members to officers.
Member: Standard guild participant with access to guild chat.
[ATTACH=full]896266[/ATTACH]

Guild Commands
All commands use the /guild prefix:

/guild create <name>: Create a new guild (sender becomes leader).
/guild invite <playerName>: Invite a player to the guild (Leader/Officer).
/guild join <guildName>: Accept a pending guild invitation.
/guild leave: Leave the current guild (disbands if leader is last member).
/guild kick <playerName>: Kick a member (Leader/Officer, officers cannot kick officers/leader).
/guild promote <playerName>: Promote a member to officer (Leader/Officer).
/guild demote <playerName>: Demote an officer to member (Leader only).
/guild disband: Disband the guild (Leader only).
/guild transfer <newLeaderName>: Transfer leadership to an online member (Leader only).
/guild info [guildName]: Show guild details (leader, members, officers, online status).
/guild list: List all guilds with leaders and member counts.
/gc <message>: send a message in the guild's chat
/guild contribute <item> <quantity>: contribute to the guild

Permissions

guildwarsplugin.use: Access basic guild commands (default: true).
guildwarsplugin.admin: Use administrative commands like disband and transfer (default: op).
guildwarsplugin.officer: Perform officer actions (invite, kick, promote) if an officer (default: false).
[ATTACH=full]896270[/ATTACH]

How to Install

Download ClashRealms.jar.
Place it in your server’s plugins folder.
Restart or reload your server.
The plugin automatically creates plugins/ClashRealms/guilds.db for data storage.
